description: MTP volume declaring 0xFFFFFFFF characters of name in a 60-byte item
notes: The four string lengths are all 0xFFFFFFFF. On a 32-bit target the characters-to-bytes multiply overflows; on a 64-bit one the slice simply runs past the end. Both have to come back as "no name" rather than a panic, which is why the fixture expects "ok": item parsing in this crate never fails.
